categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Ankura Intelligent Power Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the electric power equipment sector, focusing on cable accessories, Gas Insulated Lines (GIL) systems, smart modular substations centered on the 'open-transformer integrated machine', and smart sponge photovoltaic-storage-charging systems. The company provides comprehensive power industry chain services covering generation, transmission, transformation, distribution, storage, and usage. It also engages in power engineering design, construction, and intelligent power system services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leads in core technologies such as ultra-high voltage cable accessories (up to 750kV), three-phase common-box GIL technology, and integrated GIS switch-transformer units for smart modular substations. It employs modular, standardized, miniaturized, fully insulated, and underground-capable designs. Production methods include factory prefabrication and on-site modular assembly, with innovations in environmentally friendly insulating gases and integrated intelligent control systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major state-owned power grid companies such as State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, large industrial enterprises, data centers, renewable energy projects (solar, wind, storage), and infrastructure projects. The company serves markets related to power generation, transmission, distribution, industrial power usage, and emerging sectors like electric vehicle charging and data center power supply.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant sales in East China, South China, Central China, Southwest, Northwest, Northeast, and North China regions. It has begun expanding overseas, with initial GIL product sales in Moscow. The headquarters and main production facilities are located in Liyang, Jiangsu Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ankura operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the power supply chain, manufacturing critical transmission and transformation equipment such as cable accessories, GIL systems, and modular substations. It also provides engineering design, construction, and system integration services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in the power infrastructure supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in ultra-high voltage cable accessories, GIL technology, and smart modular substations, with ongoing R&D in environmentally friendly insulating gases and integrated intelligent power systems. It emphasizes modularization, cost reduction, and digitalization, collaborating with universities and research institutes. Future R&D includes new generation GIL products, smart transformer systems, and advanced insulation materials to support carbon neutrality and smart grid development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of products including cable accessories, GIL systems, smart modular substations, and related power system services. The company also earns income from power engineering design, construction contracts, and intelligent energy management services. Sales are mainly conducted via direct sales and bidding processes, with some new business models like leasing for modular substations being explored.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ankura is a leading private high-tech enterprise in China’s power equipment sector, recognized as a national champion in GIL technology and a pioneer in integrated GIS-transformer substations. Major competitors include domestic firms like Changchuan Technology, Hancable, Changyuan Group, Tebian Electric Apparatus, and international companies such as Nexans, Prysmian Group, ABB, Siemens, and AZZ. Ankura holds a strong market position with technological leadership and extensive project experience.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.085 billion, a 13.21% increase over 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 183 million, a 10.5% decrease. The company has shown steady revenue growth driven by expanding sales of GIL products and smart modular substations. It maintains a solid asset base with total assets exceeding RMB 3 billion and continues investing in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ankura emphasizes its technological innovation, offering products that break foreign monopolies and provide superior performance such as higher transmission capacity, reduced footprint, and enhanced safety. Its GIL technology offers 3-5 times the transmission capacity of cables with lower lifecycle costs and environmental benefits. The smart modular substations reduce construction time and land use by up to 70%, with full insulation and modular design enhancing reliability and urban compatibility. The company’s integrated solutions support green, smart, and secure power systems aligned with national carbon neutrality goals.
